prompt: Translate docs/en/welcome.md into Norwegian Bokmål and save the translation as docs/nb/welcome.md. Keep the page's Markdown: the headings, the numbered list, the bold text, the inline code and the links with their addresses. Do not change docs/en/welcome.md.

criteria.description: The translation has the source's headings and levels, list items, bold spans, inline code and link addresses, in order
Every prose block differs from the English and no four words of the English in a row remain, a link's text included
The prose reads as Norwegian Bokmål by its function words
Identical to the reference translation (wording varies; reported only)

humanReviewRubric: Is the translation accurate and natural Norwegian Bokmål?
Are the interface label in bold and the appointment code treated sensibly?
